_comment: The parameters the site's own links carry. The server answers a request with an argument it does not name with a 404 - so every name here has to be in the map on the server (/etc/nginx/conf.d/shenhe-args.conf). The gate scripts/check_link_params.py reads the built pages and checks that nothing else is used.
range: the SKUs the range builder selected, carried to the enquiry form
line: the product line the catalogue was filtered by
product: the product an enquiry is about
mode: the mode an enquiry is about (odm, private label)
about: the SKU an 'about this' link points at
interest: what a reader came for (msds, certificates)
v: the cache-buster on a picture that changed
